precepts.label: 2 Peter 2:5
precepts.why:
God told Noah, “Come thou and all thy house into the ark; for thee have I seen righteous before me in this generation.” Why was Noah chosen to be delivered with his family? Peter explains it: God “spared not the old world, but saved Noah the eighth person, a preacher of righteousness, bringing in the flood upon the world of the ungodly”.

The old world is the world we read about in Genesis 7, and God did not spare it: he killed all flesh. Noah was righteous because he preached righteousness and kept the commandments. He was a godly man in an ungodly world, and he had received his orders from God on exactly how to build the ark and did it faithfully. His standing up for God is what brought the flood in upon the ungodly.

Why is he called the eighth person? The other seven were his wife, his three sons, Shem, Ham and Japheth, and their wives. Noah is counted eighth because a true captain, a true leader, made sure his wife, his sons and their wives were on first, and he was the last one to get on the ark. When Noah gave the word, they did not question him; they got on.

That is why men of God have to be strong. We come to the Sabbath because we are sick. We are surrounded by the world all week and fighting the sin around us and in our own thoughts, so we need to be around brothers and sisters who will correct us in righteousness.

The flood shows the mind of God for destruction. Nobody was righteous except the ones on the ark. The coming destruction, a thermonuclear war, will be on another level, and we want to be spiritually the men and women in that ark, not the ones drowning. A lot more than eight will make it this time, but very few, so do not be surprised when your family does not listen. Keep the commandments, preach righteousness, and God will deliver us.

precepts.label: Zechariah 2:6-7
precepts.why:
Jacob called his sons to tell them “that which shall befall you in the last days,” and of Judah he said, “thy hand shall be in the neck of thine enemies.” That says two things: Judah will be fighting his enemy, and Judah will be living in close proximity to his enemy, who today is Esau, Edom. Zechariah 2 is the scripture that proves Judah will be living with that enemy.

“Ho, ho, come forth, and flee from the land of the north, saith the Lord: for I have spread you abroad as the four winds of the heaven, saith the Lord.” Then: “Deliver thyself, O Zion, that dwellest with the daughter of Babylon.” Zion is the city of Judah. The daughter of Babylon, as Psalms 137 shows, is Edom, the Caucasian race. So Zion is dwelling with the daughter of Babylon: Judah living in the land of the north, in the house of his enemy.

That is the picture of Genesis 49:8. Judah’s hand in the neck of his enemies is Judah living with him and contending with him. In the 1960s and 70s there was the Black Panthers, Martin Luther King, Malcolm X, and many movements where Judah rose up and fought the so-called white man. “he stooped down, he couched as a lion,” and at one point it looked like he was about to strike.

But the lion lay back down: “as an old lion; who shall rouse him up?” Christ is the one who will rouse him up. Until then the word to Zion is to come forth and deliver himself from the daughter of Babylon he dwells with.

precepts.label: Proverbs 3:1-5
precepts.why:
“The Lord is my strength and song, and he is become my salvation: he is my God”. He will guide us. Many of us choose the ways of the world to guide us: the job guides you, the children guide you. But each of us has to walk a path, some of us start to go off it, and we have to seek good and not evil. Proverbs 3 shows what his guiding looks like.

“My son, forget not my law; but let thine heart keep my commandments”. Whose law? God's laws. Your heart is your mind. You have to learn the laws and keep the commandments, and that proves the laws are the commandments. “For length of days, and long life, and peace, shall they add to thee”. You want to live long? Despite all these wars, rumors of wars and mayhem throughout the world, you want peace? Do what he said.

“Trust in the Lord with all thine heart; and lean not unto thine own understanding”. Trust that the prophecies have to go in order. Iran is not going to bring in World War III; Iran will help unite the Arabs, and you are seeing it. And lean not on your own understanding: in the Christian church some of us used to say we're already saved. No, that's not the understanding. He that endureth to the end, the same shall be saved, and we don't know when that end is coming. So we keep enduring, keeping the commandments, seeking the good and not the evil. “In all thy ways acknowledge him, and he shall direct thy paths”.

That is how the Lord becomes our salvation in Exodus 15:2: trust in him, endure to the end, and do his commandments. Then the habitation we prepare him is the kingdom, where we have power and rule and every wrong done to us is turned upside down, not the pie-in-the-sky fairy tale of modern Christianity. The Lord is a man of war, and he is using these nations to bring a final battle. I pray I make it, and I pray you make it.

precepts.label: Deuteronomy 12:2
precepts.why:
Our commandment from our God was to destroy their altars, break their images and cut down their groves. A grove is trees, and they were cut down because they were sacred trees. Moses gives the same command in Deuteronomy: “Ye shall utterly destroy all the places, wherein the nations which ye shall possess served their gods”. Destroy the places where the nations served their gods, wherever they are.

Watch where those places were: “upon the high mountains, and upon the hills, and under every green tree”. Not some trees. Under every green tree: evergreen, oak, cedar, palm, pine. Any place they served gods on a high mountain or a high hill, destroy it, and every place under a green tree, destroy it.

Read verse 3 and the command goes further: “And ye shall overthrow their altars, and break their pillars, and burn their groves with fire”. Burn the groves with fire. The Bohemian Grove, where most of the presidents, if not all of them, have gone, has an idol of Molech, the owl, standing under trees so tall all you see is the stalk. Don't focus on the owl; look at what surrounds it. The idol is under the tree. If we were in power today, that owl would be destroyed and those trees burned all around it. Burn it all.

That is why the tree matters for Exodus 34:13. The groves Israel was told to cut down are the trees the heathen worship under, and the tree set up in the house at Christmas is the same thing.

precepts.label: Hosea 4:13
precepts.why:
Hosea shows what went on under those trees: “They sacrifice upon the tops of the mountains, and burn incense upon the hills, under oaks and poplars and elms”. Oaks and poplars and elms are green trees, the same groves Exodus 34:13 says to cut down.

Why under the trees? “because the shadow thereof is good”. That owl in the Bohemian Grove sits under the shadow of those trees in the picture. The shadow of the tree is good to them because the idol is under the tree.

Then the fruit of it: “therefore your daughters shall commit whoredom, and your spouses shall commit adultery”. Around that owl they visit, they do all kinds of sexual rituals; sexual things take place around that owl at Bohemian Grove. All the presidents, including Obama, who y'all love so much, went there, and who knows what was going on over there.

So the groves were not harmless. The worship under the green tree brings whoredom and adultery with it, and that is why God commanded Israel to cut them down.

precepts.label: Ezekiel 6:13
precepts.why:
Ezekiel names the same places: “upon every high hill, in all the tops of the mountains, and under every green tree, and under every thick oak, the place where they did offer sweet savour to all their idols”. Under every green tree and under every thick oak, that is where they offered to their idols. Where did they sacrifice? Under the tree.

And God's judgment falls right there: “Then shall ye know that I am the Lord, when their slain men shall be among their idols round about their altars”. The slain lie among the idols and around the altars under the trees.

Now see what the sacrifice is called. Matthew 5:23: “Therefore if thou bring thy gift to the altar”, and “Leave there thy gift before the altar, and go thy way; first be reconciled to thy brother, and then come and offer thy gift”. The gift is the sacrifice. Matthew 8:4 says the same: “offer the gift that Moses commanded, for a testimony unto them”. Moses commanded a gift, a sacrifice.

So when the heathen sacrificed under their tree, what was under the tree? Gifts. You don't put gifts on top of the tree, beside the tree, or hang them on the tree. You put them under the tree. That is where it comes from: the gifts under the Christmas tree are the heathen's offering to their idols under every green tree.

precepts.label: Isaiah 57:5
precepts.why:
Isaiah shows what else was under the tree: “Enflaming yourselves with idols under every green tree, slaying the children in the valleys under the clifts of the rocks?” What were they doing under the tree? Slaying the children. Those children were gifts too. The children were the gifts under the tree, slain under the tree.

That is why they use the children to allure us in all the most popular holidays, Halloween and Christmas. They use the kids.

And the alluring works through gifts. Ecclesiasticus 20:29: “Presents and gifts blind the eyes of the wise, and stop up his mouth that he cannot reprove”. We have Google and technology; we can easily look it up and see that it is pagan. But we are so covetous and want that self-gratification: Thanksgiving gift, Valentine's Day gift, New Year's gift, Halloween gift, Christmas gifts, the Easter suit. The gifts stop up the mouth, so a man who knows it is wrong and evil will not say anything, and will even fight for it. Many black and brown men will battle for hours for Christmas because they are married and scared to lose a vagina. The woman got you by the balls, and she's got your balls under the damn tree, gift wrapped. You offered a gift.

You cannot make it good; it's evil. The tree and the gifts under it go back to the idols Israel was commanded to destroy, and celebrating it is celebrating the destruction of your own people with your family.

precepts.label: Deuteronomy 32:26
precepts.why:
“And they shall be upon thee for a sign and for a wonder, and upon thy seed for ever.” Why a sign? When you see a McDonald's sign, it lets you know a McDonald's is there. The curses have to be upon us for a sign because we would be cut off from our heritage, and in the future Judah will need to identify who Israel is. How do you identify the Israelites today? By the curses.

Deuteronomy 32:26 shows why: “I said, I would scatter them into corners, I would make the remembrance of them to cease from among men”. We were scattered into corners in slavery, and the remembrance of who we are, our nationality, all of it, has ceased from among men. We did not just forget because time went on. We forgot because the nations made war with us and took crafty counsel: make sure those slaves cannot read and write. They destroyed us as a people and took our nationality. Ask a Chinese man today who the Israelites are, and he points at the fake people in the land, the synagogue of Satan.

Yet go to Africa today and you will see millions of people professing that they are the people of God, the Israelites, though you will not see it on the news. Just in Nigeria there is a large Israelite community of millions. Over generations of misinterpretation and mixing customs with the Hamitic tribes they do not keep the laws the way they are supposed to, but they always knew they were Israel.

So God did it real nice. Esau would take our nationality from us, but the curses would follow us and our seed, so that no matter where we are scattered, in Africa, America, South America, China, Iran, the islands, when we read the Bible we say: wait, this is talking about my people.

precepts.label: Zechariah 12:7
precepts.why:
“Hear, Lord, the voice of Judah, and bring him unto his people”. There is Judah in Africa too, but this is speaking of Judah on this side of the earth, in the Western Hemisphere, specifically in the United States of America. Judah in North America is under Esau, who controls the world right now, and with an American passport you can go anywhere in the world. A Jamaican, Haitian or Nigerian passport cannot take you everywhere. That is why we tell you brothers: get your passport.

“The Lord also shall save the tents of Judah first”. God is going to raise up the tribe of Judah first, Judah in America. Then, when it says bring him unto his people, it means Judah will know where God's people are and will go find them. Wherever our people are in Africa, in Japan, in Iran, in India, scattered throughout the four corners of the earth, Judah will be able to identify them, find them, and teach them what God commanded of them.

That is why Genesis 49 speaks mainly of Israel on this side of the world: Judah needed to know who they were first. And it is already happening. precepts.label: Hosea 2:8
precepts.why:
Judges says Israel “served Baalim” and “forsook the Lord God of their fathers, which brought them out of the land of Egypt”. Hosea shows how ungrateful that was: “For she did not know that I gave her corn, and wine, and oil, and multiplied her silver and gold, which they prepared for Baal.”

That is what the Lord did for Israel. He clothed us, gave us land, gave us food and possessions, all of that. And we turned around and prepared it for Baal; we started serving the devil with what God gave us. Baal, Baalim, it is the same thing: the Canaanite god of fertility, storms, thunder and lightning, worshipped in horrible ways, whose name means lord or master. He sounds like Thor. Baal and Ashtaroth have taken on so many names over the ages, which is why we rarely hear of them, but the worship is coming back to light.

Even now it goes on. Just days before this class, thousands of Afro-Brazilians gathered on a Rio beach to offer gifts to a sea goddess, Yemanja, revered in the Yoruba religion as the mother of all orishas and humanity. Brazil is the tribe of Asher. It is the same deity all throughout: “the women knead their dough, to make cakes to the queen of heaven”. Ashtaroth, the queen of heaven, Yemanja, whatever the name. Our people carried that witchcraft with them and kept doing it, even in Africa.

That's our history, and that is why we are in captivity today, catching hell. The Lord clothed us and named us, yet even in 2026 our people are still worshipping the devil, and we wonder why America goes down there stealing presidents, starving people out and destabilizing countries.

precepts.label: Leviticus 18:21
precepts.why:
“And thou shalt not let any of thy seed pass through the fire to Molech, neither shalt thou profane the name of thy God: I am the Lord.” Molech worship went along with the fertility gods: it dealt with children, with the womb. That is what we were doing, and it is exactly what God told us not to do. We became bullheaded and stubborn and started worshipping the devil. That is how Israel “forsook the Lord, and served Baal and Ashtaroth.”

Stubbornness runs through this whole history. “A stubborn heart shall fare evil at the last; and he that loveth danger shall perish therein.” So we have to prophesy against the idolatry and come up out of this foolishness: Christmas, Valentine's Day, which a lot of our people celebrated. It has nothing to do with us. God did not give it to us.

“Bow down his neck while he is young, and beat him on the sides while he is a child, lest he wax stubborn”. That is why God's laws are taught without going to the left or the right: we know how we got over here, through stubbornness. If we want to be delivered, we have to wake up.

It is how Israel gets down: “when the judge was dead, that they returned, and corrupted themselves more than their fathers, in following other gods to serve them, and to bow down unto them; they ceased not from their own doings, nor from their stubborn way.” When there is no judge, no leader, in place, they go back to their lonesome: the officer's not here, the captain's not here, the Deacon's not here, the Bishop ain't here. If you can't uphold righteousness when nobody is looking, the same judgment is your future. Stubborn goes back to bullheaded, and bullheaded goes back to Baal.

“For rebellion is as the sin of witchcraft, and stubbornness is as iniquity and idolatry.” Stubbornness is idolatry; it is satanic worship. So many think they are not dabbling in the mystic arts, but when you are stubborn and rebellious, you are: “sorcerers, and idolaters, and all liars, shall have their part in the lake which burneth with fire and brimstone”.

precepts.label: 1 Samuel 15:23
precepts.why:
Judges 2:19 ends: “they ceased not from their own doings, nor from their stubborn way.” Stubborn goes back to bullheaded, and bullheaded goes back to Baal. 1 Samuel 15:23 says what stubbornness really is.

“For rebellion is as the sin of witchcraft, and stubbornness is as iniquity and idolatry.” Bullheaded, stubborn, is idolatry. It is satanic worship.

That is how Israel gets down: “when the judge was dead, that they returned, and corrupted themselves more than their fathers.” Whenever there is not a judge, a leader, in place, they go to their lonesome. They get relaxed: the officer is not here, the captain is not here, the deacon is not here, the bishop ain’t here, let’s go back to our lonesome. If that is your spirit, you are going to get the same judgment. If you can’t uphold righteousness when nobody is looking, that is your future: damnation, judgment, destruction.

Ecclesiasticus 30:12, read just before, gives the remedy: “Bow down his neck while he is young, and beat him on the sides while he is a child, lest he wax stubborn.” That is why God’s laws are taught without going to the left or to the right, and without playing games. We know how we got over here: through stubbornness. So if we want to get delivered, we have to wake the hell up.

precepts.label: Revelation 21:8
precepts.why:
1 Samuel 15:23 said rebellion is as witchcraft and stubbornness is as idolatry. Revelation 21:8 shows where the witches and the idolaters end up.

“But the fearful, and unbelieving, and the abominable, and murderers, and whoremongers, and sorcerers, and idolaters, and all liars, shall have their part in the lake which burneth with fire and brimstone.”

A lot of y’all think, I’m not dabbling in the mystic arts. Yes, you are. When you are stubborn and rebellious, yes, you are. It says sorcerers and idolaters. The one who in Judges 2:19 would not cease “from their stubborn way” is standing with the sorcerers and the idolaters, and their part is the lake of fire.

Psalms 78:8 makes the connection plain: “a stubborn and rebellious generation; a generation that set not their heart aright.” “The children of Ephraim, being armed, and carrying bows, turned back in the day of battle. They kept not the covenant of God, and refused to walk in his law.” That is the northern kingdom, though Judah did the same thing. Even when they got over here to the Americas they still did not keep the covenant, and that is why Assyria took the northern kingdom and why Columbus and Cortez came: because of the idolatry. The Lord was sick of it and still is, and this is the last time.

precepts.label: Isaiah 44:28
precepts.why:
Cyrus the Great founded the Achaemenid Empire, the old Persian kingdom, in 550 BC, and it was an ancient Iranian empire. That makes this very significant for what is going on today. “the Lord stirred up the spirit of Cyrus king of Persia”, and Cyrus proclaimed, “The Lord God of heaven hath given me all the kingdoms of the earth; and he hath charged me to build him an house at Jerusalem”.

The Lord was working through King Cyrus. The Lord did speak to him, and he listened. Isaiah had already named him: “That saith of Cyrus, He is my shepherd, and shall perform all my pleasure: even saying to Jerusalem, Thou shalt be built; and to the temple, Thy foundation shall be laid.”

So the word of the Lord by the mouth of Jeremiah was fulfilled through a Persian, an Iranian king, called by God his shepherd, who performed all his pleasure: Jerusalem built again and the foundation of the temple laid.

precepts.label: Isaiah 45:1
precepts.why:
Isaiah goes on: “Thus saith the Lord to his anointed, to Cyrus, whose right hand I have holden, to subdue nations before him; and I will loose the loins of kings, to open before him the two leaved gates; and the gates shall not be shut”.

That is why Cyrus could say, “The Lord God of heaven hath given me all the kingdoms of the earth”. The Lord held his right hand and subdued nations before him. The Lord used King Cyrus, who was a Persian, to allow us to go back and build the temple.

Cyrus is also the one who gave that decree. And the kingdom he ruled, Persia and Media, is Iran today, which is why his story is very significant for what is going on now.

precepts.label: Psalms 10:17
precepts.why:
“For Ezra had prepared his heart to seek the law of the Lord, and to do it, and to teach in Israel statutes and judgments.” What is the heart? The mind. Ezra had prepared his mind to seek the Lord his God. We are in captivity, always working and tired; some days you get stressed. But the Most High has to remind us that we are living in the last days. So brothers, prepare your minds; sisters, prepare your minds.

David shows who the Lord prepares: “Lord, thou hast heard the desire of the humble: thou wilt prepare their heart, thou wilt cause thine ear to hear”. We are the humble. We are supposed to humble ourselves to whatever the Bible says we ought to do.

And when we humble ourselves, the Lord hears our desire and prepares our hearts. We will prepare our minds. That is what Ezra did before he went to teach Israel, and that is what is required of us now, as we watch Iran and Israel go to war and America get involved, and more of our people wake up and repent.

precepts.label: Sirach 2:17
precepts.why:
Why prepare our minds and our spirits? Because war is imminent. We are seeing Iran and Israel at war and America getting involved, and the wars are only going to get worse. What we see right now is a birthing pain. Yet all of us are supposed to rejoice, because the scriptures already told us this was going to happen.

Sirach says: “They that fear the Lord will prepare their hearts, and humble their souls in his sight”. All of us that fear the Lord will prepare our minds, so that whatever evil comes upon the earth, we will remain faithful in serving the Lord.

That is Ezra's example: a heart prepared, and a soul humbled in the Lord's sight, ready to seek the law, do it, and teach it, whatever comes.

precepts.label: Sirach 33:3-4
precepts.why:
Ezra prepared his heart to seek the law and to teach it. Sirach shows why: “A man of understanding trusteth in the law; and the law is faithful unto him, as an oracle.” We must trust in the laws of God, and the law will be faithful unto us.

“Prepare what to say, and so thou shalt be heard”. We have to prepare what to say. Prepare what to say in prayer when we speak to the Most High, and we will be heard. Prepare what to say and teach in the streets, and we will be heard. We must prepare to lead, guide and organize blacks and Hispanics.

“and bind up instruction, and then make answer.” Bind up the instruction first, and then make answer. That is how Ezra could teach in Israel statutes and judgments: he had prepared his heart before he opened his mouth.

precepts.label: Ezekiel 3:17
precepts.why:
This is to the brothers who teach, the up-and-coming soldiers in the MOV program. Ezra prepared his heart to teach in Israel, and the Lord says: “Son of man, I have made thee a watchman unto the house of Israel: therefore hear the word at my mouth, and give them warning from me.”

Who is speaking? The Most High said, I have made thee a watchman. It is not the Bishop that made you a watchman. It is not the deacons, and it is not the captains. The Lord called you to be a watchman. That is why you were called into this truth: to warn our people, to warn Israel that they need to repent.

Habakkuk shows the watchman's posture: “I will stand upon my watch, and set me upon the tower”. He is awake and paying attention. As watchmen we must be faithful and pay attention to the signs of the times, hear the word at the Lord's mouth, and give Israel warning from him.

precepts.why:
“The earth is given into the hand of the wicked: he covereth the faces of the judges thereof”. Esau took over in the Renaissance. We were the judges, and he whitewashed our faces. “if not, where, and who is he?” If he didn't do it, who did? Did the Asians whitewash the image of Christ? Did the Arabs? No. The so-called white man covered the faces of the images.

And this ain't nothing new. Maccabees shows the Greeks doing it: they “laid open the book of the law, wherein the heathen had sought to paint the likeness of their images.” They opened our Bibles, and the heathen, the Greeks, sought to paint the likeness of their images in our Bibles. Even the Greeks did the exact same thing, whitewashing our images. And remember, the Renaissance is a revival of Greco-Roman culture.

The book on the icons admits it: icons existed not only as panel paintings but as frescoes and wall mosaics, some of which have emerged from layers of whitewash. What does whitewash mean? They painted over the black images. You don't whitewash white; you whitewash black. There are pictures where the face is white but the black still shows through where they painted over it. They couldn't get them all; there were too many.

So when you see the black baby Christ with his mother on one side and the white one on the other, that is the covering of the faces of the judges: the wicked, with the earth in his hand, painting his own likeness over ours.

precepts.label: Isaiah 11:14
precepts.why:
“Moab is my washpot; over Edom will I cast out my shoe; over Philistia will I triumph.” God says Moab is going to wash our clothes; they will be our laundromat forever. And he casts his shoe over Edom. That is why we are not supposed to be married to them. God says come out from among them and be ye separate. Some of us come of mixed parentage, and that is fine, but find yourself an Israelite woman, an Israelite man, and don't do this no more.

Isaiah shows the same triumph: “But they shall fly upon the shoulders of the Philistines toward the west; they shall spoil them of the east together.” We shall fly upon the shoulders of the Palestinians toward the west, and we shall spoil them of the east together.

“they shall lay their hand upon Edom and Moab; and the children of Ammon shall obey them.” We shall lay our hands upon Edom and Moab, and the children of Ammon, the Japanese, shall obey us.

So the nations that rule over Israel now, Edom, Moab and Ammon, will be under Israel's hand. That is what God means when he calls Moab his washpot and casts his shoe over Edom: they will serve.

precepts.label: Zephaniah 2:8-9
precepts.why:
God calls Moab his washpot, and Zephaniah shows why Moab and Ammon come to that end: “I have heard the reproach of Moab, and the revilings of the children of Ammon, whereby they have reproached my people, and magnified themselves against their border.”

God says, I heard what them damn Chinese said about my people, and the hatred of the Japanese. You think they love us? God says they reproach us; they hate us. They magnified themselves against the Israelites.

“Therefore as I live, saith the Lord of hosts, the God of Israel, Surely Moab shall be as Sodom, and the children of Ammon as Gomorrah, even the breeding of nettles, and saltpits, and a perpetual desolation.” Destruction upon the earth: that is nuclear fire, and it has not happened yet.

“the residue of my people shall spoil them, and the remnant of my people shall possess them.” The remnant of God's people shall spoil them, put them into captivity, and possess them; they are going to serve us. Nobody escapes, brothers and sisters. Nobody gets away with what they did to God's chosen people. And with that we say: twelve tribes.

precepts.label: Ecclesiastes 6:10
precepts.why:
“The thing that hath been, it is that which shall be”. What is the thing that hath been? Solomon says: “That which hath been is named already, and it is known that it is man”. So the thing is man.

Read Ecclesiastes 1:9 again with that: “and that which is done is that which shall be done”. The same thing man did in the past, he is going to come back and do again. “there is no new thing under the sun.” If you were wicked in the past, you are going to be wicked again when you come back on the earth. That is why the scripture says he that is righteous, let him be righteous still, and he that is evil, let him be evil still. If you are righteous, you will gravitate to righteous brothers and sisters; if you are wicked, to wicked people.

Why is this important? Because what was done to us in slavery is a circle coming back around. God's judgment is as a ring. Slavery isn't over; the white man put a fake smile on his face, and now he is showing his real face. It is the same people coming back to do the same thing. Antiochus died long ago under the Greeks, yet the scripture says he shall stand up against the Prince of princes, because the same spirit that came against the holy people is going to do it again.

So just as Egypt said, the children of Israel “are more and mightier than we”, and “let us deal wisely with them”, America, spiritual Egypt, does the same today: the census, abortions and Planned Parenthood, changing laws as we become the majority. The thing that repeats is man himself.

thread.text: Ah sinful nation, a people laden with iniquity, a seed of evildoers, children that are corrupters: they have forsaken the Lord, they have provoked the Holy One of Israel unto anger, they are gone away backward.

classes.title: Wars Are Here: Seek Good Not Evil

precepts.label: 2 Esdras 15:24
precepts.why:
Isaiah cries, “Ah sinful nation, a people laden with iniquity”. We are laden: like a ladle dipped in soup, we are soaked and drenched with iniquity. A sinful nation means we break God's laws. So what is sin? Ezra answers: “Woe to them that sin, and keep not my commandments! saith the Lord.”

Sin is when we don't keep God's commandments. Brothers, put this in your arsenal. We always go to 1 John 5:3, of course, but we have to understand that it is precept upon precept, and Ezra says the same thing.

And who are the people that were given God's commandments? The twelve tribes of Israel. That is who Isaiah is calling the sinful nation. He was never talking about the Hittites or anybody but the Israelites.

This matters now because wars are here, and it is no time to think you are ready. You may wear your fringes, keep your beard right, keep the Sabbath and put the pork down, but still battle with patience, anger, a brawling spirit, an evil eye, or the weed you won't put down. Woe to them that sin. The whole head is sick: you're sick and I'm sick, and we have to keep getting right.

precepts.label: Psalms 147:19-20
precepts.why:
Isaiah says the sinful nation has “provoked the Holy One of Israel unto anger”. To prove which nation that is: “He sheweth his word unto Jacob, his statutes and his judgments unto Israel.” Jacob was the forefather of the twelve tribes, and his name later became Israel. The statutes and the judgments were given to the nation of Israel.

“He hath not dealt so with any nation”. So for modern-day Christians to say that God is dealing with all nations and all people, they don't know the Bible.

Then: “and as for his judgments, they have not known them.” The Israelites are the ones that get judged. That is why Black people went into slavery, in the trans-Saharan slave trade and the trans-Atlantic slave trade, and many other times in history we have served our enemies in slavery.

So Isaiah was never talking about anybody but the Israelites. We are the seed of evildoers who call evil good and good evil, led astray by Christian pastors and the leaders in the mosques. From 1865 to 1965 we lived under more overt racism, but we had civility, women had a dress code, and there was an order to talk to a sister. Since 1965 we have gained almost twenty million abortions by Black women alone and the dumbest generation of children with the smartest technology. We provoked the Holy One of Israel unto anger, and that is why we went into slavery.

precepts.label: Isaiah 58:1
precepts.why:
“The burden of Babylon, which Isaiah the son of Amoz did see. Lift ye up a banner upon the high mountain, exalt the voice unto them, shake the hand.” The high mountain is the government, America. The banner we lift up upon it is the Bible. So in the midst of all this chaos, Isaiah sees the prophets still going out teaching.

“Exalt the voice unto them”: that is what we do, and Isaiah 58 says how. “Cry aloud, spare not, lift up thy voice like a trumpet, and shew my people their transgression, and the house of Jacob their sins.” We exalt the voice, we spare not, we lift up our voice as a trumpet.

“Shake the hand”: warn our people, “that they may go into the gates of the nobles.” The nations have drunk Babylon's wine, her lies and philosophies, what Daniel calls her policy, and therefore the nations are mad. War is coming, and in the midst of all that war, the prophets are still crying aloud, showing our people their transgression so they can be saved.

precepts.label: 2 Corinthians 5:11
precepts.why:
Isaiah sees the war coming on Babylon and the prophets still lifting up the banner and exalting the voice. Paul says why we do it: “Knowing therefore the terror of the Lord, we persuade men.” In Job he is called the king of terrors. We know what the Lord is going to do. The Lord set us up as watchmen, and since we know the terror of the Lord, we must persuade men.

“But we are made manifest unto God; and I trust also are made manifest in your consciences.”

Who are we trying to persuade? Our people, in the midst of all kinds of sin. So brothers, we must be studying, so that when we come across our people we are able to help them. The scripture says the whole head is sick: we are sick individuals ourselves. But we must learn to discipline ourselves, and we must learn how to persuade our people to change their lives.

precepts.label: 1 Timothy 1:9-10
precepts.why:
These are the kind of people we are trying to persuade to change: “Knowing this, that the law is not made for a righteous man, but for the lawless and disobedient, for the ungodly and for sinners, for unholy and profane.” It is for our people who are lawless.

“For murderers of fathers and murderers of mothers.” If you knew a brother murdered his father or his mother, you would not treat him the same; your instant reaction is, bro, you cold, who does that? “For manslayers”: imagine being cool with a brother and not knowing the whole time he had bodies on him. But there is repentance for those spirits. These are the spirits we are trying to win over and get to submit to the Lord.

“For whoremongers, for them that defile themselves with mankind”: women with all kinds of men, men with all kinds of women, and homosexuality. There is repentance for all of these sins. Some of us are struggling with one, two, three, four, five of these. God damn. We have demons on us.

The only way to get it out is to have one counsellor of a thousand and open up. That is the problem: some of you don't want to open up, and by the time we find out what you are struggling with, it's too late to help. It doesn't mean you can't repent, but it is a lot harder because you kept it secret so long, and by the time you tell us you are already having sex and we have to throw you out. Repent, submit yourself to the Lord, and stay close with the pack.

“For menstealers, for liars, for perjured persons, and if there be any other thing that is contrary to sound doctrine.” How many of us lie? We all lie. Why didn't you come to the Sabbath? My back, I was tired: a lie. Why didn't you come to the new moon? I got off work late: a lie, because in your mind you already said, I'll go next time.

Can you persuade a murderer, a lesbian, a homosexual to change their life? Can you turn a liar or a thief into a soldier? You can, and the proof is that you are sitting in the building. Don't say only Deacon Eythan or Black Rhino knows how to talk to people.

precepts.label: 2 Esdras 16:63-64
precepts.why:
We are to persuade our people, but this is what we have to overcome: “Surely he knoweth your inventions, and what ye think in your hearts, even them that sin, and would hide their sin.” That is what we do. We sin, and we hide our sin.

The Lord says, I know your inventions. I know why you watch HBO at night; I know why you like Spartacus, why you like Power. I know you love to smoke weed and spray yourself with cologne right before you come to the Sabbath, and then security says, that brother smells like weed. Keep smoking weed and you will end up face down in the street like the man in the video, calling the officer papi.

Some brothers are tied to unbelieving wives who cook pork on the same grill next to your lawful food, still go to the club and don't respect you, and you refuse to leave. Sisters are tied to unbelieving men. There is no love among our people, and we are caught up in these sins, lawless, like 1 Timothy 1:9.

You can hide it from the brothers and the sisters, but you cannot hide it from the Lord. He knows your inventions and what you think in your heart. So before we can persuade our people, we have to get ourselves right.

precepts.label: 2 Esdras 7:61
precepts.why:
“That there should not be such heaviness in their destruction, as shall be joy over them that are persuaded to salvation.” We must persuade men to salvation. We see the wars going on with Iran; we see the prophecies coming to pass and escalating. But the Lord told us, go persuade my people to salvation, go bring them into the sanctuary.

How do we do it? Proverbs 25:15: “By long forbearing is a prince persuaded, and a soft tongue breaketh the bone.” To forbear is to patiently restrain. A prince is a very high rank, and with long patience you can persuade even princes. And what does Israel mean? Prince of the power. We have to be patient with the Israelites.

As teachers, be patient and strategic. When you are having that conversation, don't think they are just wicked as hell; they might actually repent, but you were not patient enough. Be diplomatic, learn how to reason. When people come up to you in the street, don't hit them with the first death scripture. You were once in that spot, and the only reason we are in this building is that the Lord opened our eyes.

A soft tongue breaks the bone: somebody can be pissed with you, and you respond with peace. You from Brooklyn, from DC, from PG County, want to respond even more aggressive. But the joy over one of our people persuaded to salvation is greater than the heaviness over the destruction of the rest.

precepts.label: Revelation 17:5
precepts.why:
Isaiah says “thou shalt take up this proverb against the king of Babylon.” We know from Psalms 137 that the United States of America is the daughter of Babylon, and Isaiah is speaking prophetically of Babylon the Great to come, the same one John wrote about in Revelation.

“And upon her forehead was a name written, MYSTERY, BABYLON THE GREAT, THE MOTHER OF HARLOTS.” Is that saying Babylon is one big brothel, with the main hoe in the United States pimping out the other hoes? No. It is similitude.

Think about who wrote it. John lived way after Isaiah, during the Roman Empire, long after ancient Babylon had fallen. Why would John be writing about ancient Babylon? He is talking about the same Babylon the Great Isaiah saw: the United States of America. This is not talking about Iraq.

Everybody sees it except the Israelites. They will say no one knows who this is. Are you kidding me? Our Black people, our Hispanics and Native Americans who cannot see it, we hope the Lord opens your eyes.

That is why Isaiah asks, “Is this the man that made the earth to tremble, that did shake kingdoms; That made the world as a wilderness, and destroyed the cities thereof?” The man is the so-called white man running the United States, whose real power began with the atomic bombs on Hiroshima and Nagasaki in '45. He is weakening the nations, even his own allies like India and Japan, which depend on oil coming through the Strait of Hormuz, and God is hardening the hearts of Trump's circle to do just what he wants, as he did with Egypt.

precepts.why:
“How art thou fallen from heaven, O Lucifer, son of the morning! how art thou cut down to the ground, which didst weaken the nations!” This is what Lucifer does, what the beast does. Iran has not forgotten what America did, and God has not forgotten what America is doing in the earth right now and all the evil it has done before. “Which didst weaken the nations”: they have Cuba on its knees right now, and those are our brothers and sisters over there. Trump threatened tariffs on any country that sells oil to Cuba, said there will be no more oil or money going to Cuba, zero, and put pressure on Mexico until Mexico pulled away. Then he says Cuba looks ready to fall. Why is it ready to fall? Because you are causing it, Trump. It is the same thing they did to Iran, and to Venezuela. This is what they do everywhere they go.

Ezra names that beast: “Art not thou it that remainest of the four beasts, whom I made to reign in my world, that the end of their times might come through them?” Esau is the fourth beast, and he is going to bring the end of the times; you can see why.

“And the fourth came, and overcame all the beasts that were past, and had power over the world with great fearfulness, and over the whole compass of the earth with much wicked oppression.” Power over the whole compass of the earth, with much wicked oppression: that is America weakening the nations, and that is why it will be cut down to the ground.

thread.label: Isaiah 15:1-2
thread.text: The burden of Moab. Because in the night Ar of Moab is laid waste, and brought to silence; because in the night Kir of Moab is laid waste, and brought to silence;

classes.title: The Madmen Of China And Their Hatred For Black People

precepts.label: Revelation 11:8
precepts.why:
“The burden of Moab. Because in the night Ar of Moab is laid waste, and brought to silence; because in the night Kir of Moab is laid waste.” Ar and Kir are cities of Moab. This took place under Nebuchadnezzar, when Babylon came in smiting Moab. But there is more to it, and we go to Revelation to see it.

“And their dead bodies shall lie in the street of the great city.” The dead bodies are the spiritually dead bodies of the Israelites. And the great city is Babylon the great. That is the point to hold: Revelation speaks of a great city, a Babylon, in the last days, where our people lie spiritually dead in the street.

So Babylon is not only the kingdom of Nebuchadnezzar. There is a Babylon of the last days as well, and Revelation 14:8 names it: “Babylon is fallen, is fallen, that great city.” When Isaiah shows Babylon laying Moab waste in the night, bringing its cities to silence, and Moab howling over Nebo and Medeba with baldness on every head and every beard cut off, it carries a dual meaning. Moab, which today is China, the Vietnamese and the Mongolians, will be laid waste again, and the great city where our people lie spiritually dead is the Babylon of today.

precepts.label: Revelation 14:8
precepts.why:
Revelation 11:8 speaks of “the great city.” Revelation 14 proves which city that is: “And there followed another angel, saying, Babylon is fallen, is fallen, that great city, because she made all nations drink of the wine of the wrath of her fornication.”

The great city is Babylon, the one that made all nations drink of the wine of the wrath of her fornication. This place, America, is a spiritual Babylon. It is not the actual Babylon under Nebuchadnezzar, but this place God calls Babylon the great.

That is why we went there from Isaiah 15. Isaiah’s burden of Moab took place when Babylon under Nebuchadnezzar smote Moab: Ar of Moab and Kir of Moab, cities of Moab, “laid waste, and brought to silence” in the night. Moab went up to the high places to weep and howled over Nebo and Medeba, and “on all their heads shall be baldness, and every beard cut off”, because Moab shaves off its hair in great sorrow and mourning, a custom that remains in their religions to this day, in the head shaving of the monks and nuns of Chinese religion.

precepts.why:

Amos tells what Ammon did to get there: “For three transgressions of the children of Ammon, and for four, I will not turn away the punishment thereof; because they have ripped up the women with child of Gilead, that they might enlarge their border.”

When they caught our people, they ripped up the women with child. They hung them upside down, just like the white man did to us, cut their stomachs so the baby fell out, and crushed the babies. That is what the Bible says they did, and why: they wanted to enlarge their border and take over our lands. They slaughtered Gad. God says, I'm not forgiving you for that; I'm not letting you slide.

“But I will kindle a fire in the wall of Rabbah, and it shall devour the palaces thereof, with shouting in the day of battle, with a tempest in the day of the whirlwind.” Rabbah is the city of Jeremiah 49:2, where the Lord will cause “an alarm of war” to be heard. A day of battle is coming, with a tempest in the day of the whirlwind: that's the Lord.

“And their king shall go into captivity, he and his princes together, saith the Lord.” Put the leader of North Korea, Kim Jong-un, on the screen. Whether it is that particular man or not, whoever is the leader in the land of Ammon at that time is going to be a prisoner of war. That is what the prophecy says, so look for it.

precepts.label: Romans 8:17
precepts.why:
“then shall Israel be heir unto them that were his heirs, saith the Lord.” What does that mean? Romans 8 jumps right to it: “And if children, then heirs; heirs of God, and joint-heirs with Christ; if so be that we suffer with him, that we may be also glorified together.”

We are joint-heirs with Christ. Ammon made itself heir to Gad, inheriting his cities while Israel was carried away. But Israel is the heir of God, and in that day Israel shall be heir unto them that took his inheritance.

The condition is that we suffer with him, that we may also be glorified together. The suffering comes first, the inheritance after, just as Gad lost his cities and the Lord promises to give them back.

precepts.label: Obadiah 1:19
precepts.why:
The prophets show whose the land will be: “And they of the south shall possess the mount of Esau”: we're going to own Esau. “and they of the plain the Philistines”: we're going to own them as well. “and they shall possess the fields of Ephraim, and the fields of Samaria”: we're going to get our lands back. “and Benjamin shall possess Gilead.”

The tribe of Benjamin, God foretells, will dwell in the land of Gilead. That is the land of Gad and Reuben and half of Manasseh, the same Gilead whose women with child Ammon ripped up to enlarge their border.

So the prophecy says God is going to give that land in the future to Benjamin. That is Israel being “heir unto them that were his heirs”: the land Ammon took is given back to Israel.

precepts.label: Numbers 32:29
precepts.why:
Before Obadiah's prophecy, the history of the land: when we entered the land, Moses already had it mapped out for us. “If the children of Gad and the children of Reuben will pass with you over Jordan, every man armed to battle, before the Lord, and the land shall be subdued before you; then ye shall give them the land of Gilead for a possession.”

So you notice: Gad and Reuben, that was to be their land. Gilead was Gad's by the word of Moses. That is why Jeremiah asks, “why then doth their king inherit Gad”: the land was Israel's possession, given before the Lord, and Ammon had no right to it.

precepts.label: Numbers 32:39
precepts.why:
“And the children of Machir the son of Manasseh went to Gilead, and took it, and dispossessed the Amorite which was in it.” So you had Gad, Reuben and Manasseh in that land. But in the prophecy of Obadiah, God says Benjamin shall possess Gilead.

On the ancient map you can see Manasseh, Gad under them, and Reuben under Gad, and right next to Gad was Ammon. When Gad was moved out of the land by the Assyrian captivity, Ammon moved right in. That is what Jeremiah 49:1 says: “their king inherit Gad, and his people dwell in his cities.”

After Nebuchadnezzar began to move them out, then the Persians, then the Greeks, the Arabs got the land of Ammon; the Greeks made a deal with them, as the book of the Maccabees tells. On the modern map it is spelled Amman, and that whole area is what America calls Jordan today. It is all Arab land, but it was Ammon and Moab's land, and before that it was Gilead, Israel's land.

precepts.label: Deuteronomy 28:64
precepts.why:
“And the Lord shall scatter thee among all people, from the one end of the earth even unto the other; and there thou shalt serve other gods, which neither thou nor thy fathers have known, even wood and stone.”

We were scattered everywhere, and that includes, as we are finding out, China and Japan. The paintings from Japan in the 1400s and 1500s show the black faces, and the black faces are slaves, brought over by the Portuguese and Spanish. In ancient China the Kunlun, African slaves, were given as tribute gifts during the Tang dynasty, and slavery peaked under the Tang and Song dynasties. The Portuguese brought enslaved Africans to Macau in large numbers in the 1500s, where they formed the core of its defense and defeated the Dutch in the Battle of Macau in 1622.

You don't learn this in school, and you definitely ain't going to learn it in Sunday school. They keep it secret and hidden. We thought these people were our friends; they had us as slaves too. That is why no nation wants to give us reparations: all nations got to pay.

This is how Israel came to be among all people from one end of the earth to the other, and why the question stands: “Hath Israel no sons? hath he no heir?” The Lord answers that Israel shall be heir again.

The word of the Lord told Ezekiel, “Son of man, set thy face against mount Seir, and prophesy against it”. To know who Mount Seir is, go to Genesis 36. Esau took his wives, his sons, his daughters, his cattle and all his substance “and went into the country from the face of his brother Jacob”, because “the land wherein they were strangers could not bear them because of their cattle.” “Thus dwelt Esau in mount Seir: Esau is Edom.”

precepts.label: Isaiah 45:14
precepts.why:
The second beast is “like to a bear”, and the bear is the Persians and the Medes. “it raised up itself on one side”: Persia raised itself up, because through King Cyrus, Persia became mightier than Media. “and it had three ribs in the mouth of it between the teeth of it”. What three nations do those ribs represent? Isaiah 45:14 answers: “Thus saith the Lord, The labour of Egypt, and merchandise of Ethiopia and of the Sabeans”. The three ribs are Egypt, Ethiopia and the Sabeans, the nations Persia conquered.

This kingdom of Persia and Media is very significant for what is going on today. The Achaemenid Empire of Old Persian was an ancient Iranian empire, founded by Cyrus the Great in 550 BC. The bear of Daniel 7 is Iran.

And the Lord worked through that Persian king. “the Lord stirred up the spirit of Cyrus king of Persia”, and Cyrus proclaimed, “The Lord God of heaven hath given me all the kingdoms of the earth; and he hath charged me to build him an house at Jerusalem, which is in Judah.” The Lord spoke to him, and he listened. Isaiah says of him, “He is my shepherd, and shall perform all my pleasure: even saying to Jerusalem, Thou shalt be built; and to the temple, Thy foundation shall be laid.” And the chapter of the three ribs opens, “Thus saith the Lord to his anointed, to Cyrus, whose right hand I have holden, to subdue nations before him”.

So the Lord used King Cyrus, a Persian, to let us go back and build the temple, and gave him Egypt, Ethiopia and the Sabeans to devour. That is why the bear rose up on one side, and why the land of Persia, Iran, stands in prophecy for the days we are in.

precepts.label: Daniel 9:27
precepts.why:
“the robbers of thy people shall exalt themselves to establish the vision”. Who are the robbers of God's people? Daniel 9:27 shows what they do: “And he shall confirm the covenant with many for one week: and in the midst of the week he shall cause the sacrifice and the oblation to cease”. This is what Antiochus did: he stopped us from sacrificing and serving God.

“and for the overspreading of abominations he shall make it desolate”: he set up abomination and made our people desolate, meaning he destroyed our people, “even until the consummation”. That is why the Greeks, and the white man after them, are called the abomination of desolation, the abomination that maketh desolate. They are the robbers of God's people.

The Greeks wanted to conquer and take the land of Israel, and not only the land. First Maccabees 3 shows they took the book of the law and painted their likeness and their images in it, robbing us of our culture too. Judas Maccabeus rose up and fought against them.

And it is not only the Greeks. Christ said, “When ye therefore shall see the abomination of desolation, spoken of by Daniel the prophet, stand in the holy place”. In the time of the Greeks the abomination was the Greeks; in the time of Christ it was the Romans; and Europe is an extension of Rome. In 1949 Europeans from Germany, Poland, Russia and Ukraine went into the holy land saying, we are the people of God. Today the abomination of desolation is those people in the land calling themselves Jews and they are not: the Europeans, the Edomites. Why are they called that? Because they destroy everything; ask the Palestinians.

When they stand in the holy place, “then shall be great tribulation, such as was not since the beginning of the world to this time, no, nor ever shall be.” They are the ones who will instigate it. But Daniel 11:14 ends, “but they shall fall.” The same way they fell back then is the same way they are going to fall today.

To oppose means you go against. Daniel said the king would “exalt himself, and magnify himself above every god”; the Greeks did this, Rome did this, and America has done the same thing.

“so that he as God sitteth in the temple of God”: his temples are the temples of God. “shewing himself that he is God”: all his images show him as God, as the Son of God, as the angels, as the Jews. What we read in 2 Thessalonians 2 is the same thing Daniel prophesied the white man would do.

In the Pillory, the tale of the Borgia pope, explains it: it is an open secret that Cesare Borgia, the son of Pope Alexander, posed for the new image of Jesus, with the crown of thorns and the thin hair; Salvator means Saviour. That is the strange god Daniel spoke of, “a god whom his fathers knew not”, which “he shall acknowledge and increase with glory”.

Paul warned of it: “For if he that cometh preacheth another Jesus, whom we have not preached, or if ye receive another spirit, which ye have not received, or another gospel, which ye have not accepted”. This is another Jesus; you won't find a scripture describing Jesus like this. And what comes with another Jesus is another spirit, an antichrist spirit, and another gospel. Black Christians love to say it doesn't matter what he looks like, only his message; but a gospel where all races come together in the name of white Jesus, the apostles never taught or accepted. That ain't in the Bible.

He has fooled the world into thinking he serves the God of the Bible, but he does not. He honours “the God of forces”, the god of weaponry and destruction, he causes his lieutenants and generals “to rule over many”, and he divides “the land for gain”, as Alexander's four generals did, and as Europe divided up Africa at the Berlin Conference.

thread.text: For the children of Israel shall abide many days without a king, and without a prince, and without a sacrifice, and without an image, and without an ephod, and without teraphim:

classes.title: Judgement! To Hell with Your Reparations!
God, Purpose, and Sacrifice

precepts.label: Daniel 12:6-7
precepts.why:
Hosea says the children of Israel “shall abide many days without a king, and without a prince, and without a sacrifice, and without an image, and without an ephod”. Daniel 12 gives the time frame for it. “How long shall it be to the end of these wonders?” The wonders are our people being destroyed, enslaved and colonized, being without a king, without a prince, without an ephod.

“it shall be for a time, times, and an half”. A time is a hundred years; times is two hundred, three hundred in all; and an half makes 350 years. “and when he shall have accomplished to scatter the power of the holy people, all these things shall be finished.” Within those 350 years we were totally destroyed. All that power was gone from us; we forgot who we are, and we even forgot our nationality.

When we fled Jerusalem in 70 AD, was our power destroyed? Our country was destroyed, but we went to Africa and built cities there, and the ten tribes were set up on this side of the world doing their thing too. We still had governments, we still had kings over us, and we still knew we were the children of Israel. It was within the slave trade and colonization that the power of the holy people was scattered.

That is the many days without a king: without political sovereignty, when Europe colonized Ghana, Nigeria, Angola, Senegal, Papua New Guinea and the Congo, and when the transatlantic slave trade took us. It is without an image: our minds destroyed until the sisters in Africa bleach their skin and put on weaves, because worshipping the God of your oppressor destroys the way you look at yourself. The same curses fell on our people all over Africa, like the Mau Mau in Kenya, tortured in British camps and paid less than 4,000 pounds each. That is why I don't want no damn reparations.

precepts.label: Daniel 12:11
precepts.why:
Daniel 12 gives the time frame for when our people would be without a king, without an image, and without a sacrifice, as Hosea 3:4 says. Verse 11 reads: “And from the time that the daily sacrifice shall be taken away, and the abomination that maketh desolate set up, there shall be a thousand two hundred and ninety days.”

The daily sacrifice taken away is Hosea's “without a sacrifice”. Without the sacrifice, the image and the ephod, all our religious infrastructure and spiritual guidance was stripped away, and there was no priest to guide us and tell us what God needs us to do. The white man came in, whipped us, taught us white Jesus and his lies, and forced it down our throats in Africa. After he brought the slaves over here, he went to Africa and destroyed them there, until the people in Africa don't even know that we in the Caribbean and America are the same people.

So from the taking away of the sacrifice, the days are counted, and the question Daniel asked, “How long shall it be to the end of these wonders?”, is answered with a set time. That goes back to the yoke of iron upon thy neck until thou have been destroyed: it did not just happen to us over here, it happened to our people in Africa, and the scattering of the holy people runs its appointed course.

precepts.label: Hosea 9:13-14
precepts.why:
“Ephraim, he hath mixed himself among the people; Ephraim is a cake not turned.” Think of a pancake: the top is white and the bottom is brown. We still have that, but you have a lot of light skin, and it was strategic. The whitening campaigns across Latin America were a war on blackness, meant to make us forget our heritage: grandmothers praising good hair and light babies, textbooks erasing black heroes, children taught not to embrace their nose, their lips or their skin. That is how you colonize a people from the inside out. This devil is very evil and very strategic, but there is a God.

“Ephraim, as I saw Tyrus, is planted in a pleasant place: but Ephraim shall bring forth his children to the murderer.” The pleasant place is the island of Puerto Rico. Ephraim and Manasseh are Joseph. “Give them, O Lord: what wilt thou give? give them a miscarrying womb and dry breasts.”

A lot of misinformed and uneducated people think the northern kingdom is not Israel just because they are light-skinned. No. The Lord knows exactly who they are, and the Lord made sure the seed would continue. It doesn't matter if they are light or dark; the Lord knows who is who, just as he knew that Asher would land in Brazil, and Brazil is Hebrew for iron. The Lord didn't make a mistake.

So the cake not turned is still Ephraim. Mixed among the people and whitened on top, brought forth to the murderer in a pleasant place, the northern kingdom is still the children of Israel, and the curses on them prove it.

precepts.label: Isaiah 43:5
precepts.why:
Hosea says the Lord “shall roar like a lion: when he shall roar, then the children shall tremble from the west.” The west is the western hemisphere, where the tribes are primarily scattered.

Isaiah says the same: “Fear not: for I am with thee: I will bring thy seed from the east, and gather thee from the west”. The Lord gathers his children from where they are, and the west is where most of them are, here in America and this side of the world.

So when the Lord roars, the children who tremble and walk after him come from the west, and he gathers them. That is the hope for the tribes over here, but it comes with a warning. Before this the class read that Babylon's “sins have reached unto heaven”, and that we must come out of the ways of America and out of her idolatry. If we don't repent of our stubbornness, our bullheadedness and our idolatry, we will get the same judgment as her. The seed that is gathered from the west is the seed that answers the roar and walks after the Lord.

precepts.label: Zechariah 8:7-8
precepts.why:
“Thus saith the Lord of hosts; Behold, I will save my people from the east country, and from the west country”. The children who tremble from the west in Hosea are the ones the Lord saves from the west country. “And I will bring them, and they shall dwell in the midst of Jerusalem: and they shall be my people, and I will be their God, in truth and in righteousness.”

Remember what the Jewish Encyclopedia said earlier in the class about Arzareth: the land beyond the great river, far from the habitation of man, where the ten tribes of Israel would dwell observing the laws of Moses until the time of the restoration, and Columbus identified America with that land. It was prophesied that we would be over here until the time of restoration. This is that restoration: the Lord bringing us from the west country to dwell in the midst of Jerusalem.

And it is “in truth and in righteousness”. That is why the class closed on idolatry: “the worshipping of idols not to be named is the beginning, the cause, and the end, of all evil”, and our stubbornness and disdain for God's commandments are idolatry. Flee from idolatry, so that you are among the people he brings back.

precepts.label: Psalms 17:13
precepts.why:
Amos says, “And though they go into captivity before their enemies, thence will I command the sword, and it shall slay them”. Who is the sword? The wicked at the time. David shows it: “Arise, O Lord, disappoint him, cast him down: deliver my soul from the wicked, which is thy sword”, and he goes on, “From men which are thy hand, O Lord”.

God wields the wicked as his sword. The wicked today is the United States. He is going to use them to bring in all these wars you are seeing, and we have to get right.

That is why we can't bug out or get caught up in everything going on. Nobody wants to see Arab children losing limbs; nobody wants to see destruction. But we understand why it is happening, and we understand what we have to do, so that when the final war comes, he that endureth to the end shall be saved. That is what we want: deliverance.

So it was with us. The twelve tribes went into captivity after captivity before our enemies, because God allowed every bit of it. He commanded the sword and it slew us, and he set his eyes upon us “for evil, and not for good”, because we did not keep the commandments. The Iranians don't get a pass; they had us in captivity too, as did the princes of Ishmael. There is slavery happening right now in parts of Africa, and it is not Black Americans or Israelites running it, but Arabs and Caucasians with financial power. Wars are here: seek good and not evil.

precepts.label: Isaiah 46:10
precepts.why:
Amos says “the Lord God of hosts is he that toucheth the land”. When Iran is being touched right now, and Israel, the Lord is involved in all of it; by his counsel the land gets touched. Isaiah shows that counsel: “Declaring the end from the beginning, and from ancient times the things that are not yet done”.

This is the power we have: understanding that the Most High God from the very beginning planned every war, including the third world war to come. Ancient times means way back when Adam and Eve walked. From then he declared it. As his sons and daughters, the Israelites, we have to know our Father has this covered and his Son is coming back. Right now we have to rehearse the righteous acts and get right.

That is how we can make the bold statement that God is behind the Israelis doing what they do in the US government, and behind the Iranians spending twenty years building huge, elaborate tunnel systems and storing munitions and advanced rocketry. All of it was set up from ancient times. They send drones that cost fifteen to twenty thousand dollars, and the other side fires interceptor missiles that cost a million or more to take them out. You see how they will not be able to keep up. God put all that in these leaders.

“My counsel shall stand, and I will do all my pleasure”. It was his pleasure when we went into chattel slavery, through Jim Crow and through civil rights. We had to learn the lesson.

Jeremiah shows the same counsel: “Therefore hear ye the counsel of the Lord, that he hath taken against Babylon”. “Surely the least of the flock shall draw them out”: Israel, the least of Esau's flock, draws the United States out into the Middle East, and “At the noise of the taking of Babylon the earth is moved”. Amos lived way before anything could melt the land. Today thermonuclear ICBMs can, and it is all by his counsel.

Micah says, “they covet fields, and take them by violence; and houses, and take them away: so they oppress a man and his house, even a man and his heritage.” Even a man and his heritage: these lands were given to us by God. Ezra says why: “All this have I spoken before thee, O Lord, because thou madest the world for our sakes”.

For whose sake? Our sake. Not everybody's sake: our sake. The enemy knows that. Esau knows that the world was made for our sake, so he has to create laws to remove us, set puppet presidents up, and pass laws against us.

That is how they covet the fields. They want our lands; they want to be the landlords. They take them by any means necessary: by fires, by earthquakes, by murder, deception, creating laws and setting up puppet presidents. They take our houses, and that is why we migrate and get displaced: our lands are burned and destroyed and taken from us for the precious resources, the minerals underneath. So they oppress an Israelite man and his house, where he is from and where he lives.

Now they give visas to Israeli nationals, who come to our lands and buy up property. When we go to Ecuador, Peru and Guatemala, you see them coming in on free visas, allowed to buy property, while the people of the land have to jump through hoops and hurdles just to keep the lot they have. In Argentina the laws were changed so that foreigners could buy land, and the state of Israel is buying up land at cheap prices. It is the heritage God gave us, and the world made for our sakes, that they are after.

precepts.label: Ecclesiasticus 10:12
precepts.why:
Zephaniah says, “for then I will take away out of the midst of thee them that rejoice in thy pride”. Who rejoices in our pride? Sirach proves what pride is: “The beginning of pride is when one departeth from God”.

Pride is departing from God, going against his commandments; it is our sin. So those that rejoice in our pride are the ones that rejoice in us going against God's commandments: the pastors, the Christians, the churches, the Democrats and the Republicans. They rejoice in us not keeping God's commandments. The Lord says, I am going to take them out of you, take them away from you, “and thou shalt no more be haughty because of my holy mountain”, the land of Israel.

What he leaves is “an afflicted and poor people, and they shall trust in the name of the Lord.” The elect beyond the rivers of Ethiopia, the daughter of his dispersed, a large portion of them on the continent of Africa, are afflicted and very poor, as we saw going throughout Africa keeping Passover and the feast of unleavened bread. They must be taught to trust in the name of the Lord.

“The remnant of Israel shall not do iniquity, nor speak lies”, because they are being taught the commandments, and that is what we go out there for. No, Jesus is not white; no, he was not born December 25th; no, we are not to pray to Mary or to the ancestors. Sin has always been the problem, and breaking God's commandments is a sign of unbelief. When the ones who rejoice in our departing from God are taken away, the remnant shall feed and lie down, and none shall make them afraid.

thread.label: Zechariah 2:6-8
thread.text: Ho, ho, come forth, and flee from the land of the north, saith the Lord: for I have spread you abroad as the four winds of the heaven, saith the Lord.

classes.title: Recovering the Remnant: Worldwide Blitz

precepts.label: Psalms 78:68
precepts.why:
Zechariah says, “come forth, and flee from the land of the north”: flee from North America. “for I have spread you abroad as the four winds of the heaven”: all Israel scattered, like we read in Matthew 24 and James 1. Then he singles out one group: “Deliver thyself, O Zion, that dwellest with the daughter of Babylon.”

Many scriptures tell us that Zion represents the twelve tribes. But in this context, which Zion is it? Asaph answers: “But chose the tribe of Judah, the mount Zion which he loved.” That is the Zion right there.

So “Deliver thyself, O Zion” is talking about Judah: deliver yourself, Judah. That does not mean all the Judahites are in the land of the north; Judah was dispersed like all the other tribes. But God is pinpointing a particular group of Judah that would be in the land of the north, dwelling with the daughter of Babylon.

That fits the rest of the prophecy. In these last days the Lord raises up Judah first: the Lord “shall save the tents of Judah first”, and the blessing of Judah is, “Hear, Lord, the voice of Judah, and bring him unto his people.” The voice of Judah is the teaching of Judah, carried to the other eleven tribes.

precepts.label: Psalms 137:7-8
precepts.why:
Zechariah says Zion, Judah, “dwellest with the daughter of Babylon.” The key is who the daughter of Babylon is. The psalm names her: “Remember, O Lord, the children of Edom in the day of Jerusalem; who said, Rase it, rase it, even to the foundation thereof.” The word rase means destroy it: destroy it even to the foundation.

Then the very next words: “O daughter of Babylon.” Notice what it is calling them now. It is calling Edom, the so-called white folks, the daughter of Babylon.

So the scripture lets you know Judah would live among Edom, and where? In the land of the north. That is why the Lord cries, “Ho, ho, come forth, and flee from the land of the north.” The group of Judah in North America is dwelling with the daughter of Babylon, the children of Edom who wanted Jerusalem razed to the ground.

And the Lord's word to that people is: “he that toucheth you toucheth the apple of his eye.” We are God's favorite, and the nations which spoiled us will answer for it.

precepts.label: 2 Chronicles 20:12
precepts.why:
“The burden of the word of the Lord in the land of Hadrach, and Damascus shall be the rest thereof”: this is Syria. And it comes “when the eyes of man, as of all the tribes of Israel, shall be toward the Lord.” All the eyes of Israel, our people, shall be toward the Lord.

2 Chronicles 20:12 has the wording for it: “O our God, wilt thou not judge them? for we have no might against this great company that cometh against us; neither know we what to do: but our eyes are upon thee.” That is what we are saying to the Lord.

The nations are at war around Syria, Lebanon, Gaza and Ashkelon, and we have no might against that great company. We do not know what to do. So we keep our eyes on the Lord, and we have to put our attention toward him. That is the moment Zechariah is speaking of, when the burden of the Lord falls on those lands and all the tribes of Israel look to him.

precepts.label: Leviticus 17:10-14
precepts.why:
Zechariah 9:7 says “And I will take away his blood out of his mouth, and his abominations from between his teeth”. First the scripture about blood: “whatsoever man there be of the house of Israel, or of the strangers that sojourn among you, that eateth any manner of blood; I will even set my face against that soul that eateth blood, and will cut him off from among his people. For the life of the flesh is in the blood”.

“Therefore I said unto the children of Israel, No soul of you shall eat blood”. Whoever hunts and catches a beast or fowl “shall even pour out the blood thereof, and cover it with dust.” “Ye shall eat the blood of no manner of flesh: for the life of all flesh is the blood thereof: whosoever eateth it shall be cut off.” That includes those of you who came from Santo Domingo: you are not to be eating blood sausage, black sausage. Don't eat that.

Now look at the blood in his mouth and the abomination between his teeth. These people, these bastards in Ashdod, in the ritual they call metzitzah b'peh, remove the foreskin of the baby and put their mouth on the wound and suck the blood from it. Infants have caught herpes from it, and the rabbis in New York negotiate to keep doing it. That is an abomination from between your teeth. What the hell is wrong with you? Your mom ain't teach you nothing?

One man called them a militarized vampire nation, living on death and destruction, on blood. Ezekiel 35:5-6 says it of Esau: because thou hast had a perpetual hatred and shed the blood of the children of Israel, “sith thou hast not hated blood, even blood shall pursue thee.” The Most High is exposing them: the bloody mattress and baby clothes in the tunnels in Brooklyn, the baby clothes and toys on Epstein Island. God will take away the blood out of his mouth.

precepts.label: 2 Samuel 5:8
precepts.why:
Zechariah 9:7 ends: “but he that remaineth, even he, shall be for our God, and he shall be as a governor in Judah, and Ekron as a Jebusite.” He that remaineth is you and I. And on the map, Ekron sits right there above Jerusalem.

What does it mean to be as a Jebusite? “And David said on that day, Whosoever getteth up to the gutter, and smiteth the Jebusites, and the lame and the blind, that are hated of David’s soul, he shall be chief and captain. Wherefore they said, The blind and the lame shall not come into the house. So David dwelt in the fort, and called it the city of David.”

When you read the history, David smote the Jebusites and made them servants. That is what he did. So when Zechariah says “Ekron as a Jebusite”, the land that the Philistines hold will be brought under Israel the way David brought the Jebusites under him.

precepts.label: 1 Kings 9:20-21
precepts.why:
“And all the people that were left of the Amorites, Hittites, Perizzites, Hivites, and Jebusites, which were not of the children of Israel, Their children that were left after them in the land, whom the children of Israel also were not able utterly to destroy, upon those did Solomon levy a tribute of bondservice unto this day.”

They were our servants, our slaves. The Jebusites left in the land did not rule over Israel; Solomon put them under a tribute of bondservice.

So when we go back to the last part of Zechariah 9:7, “and Ekron as a Jebusite”, it means they are going to be our servants. Those that are left of the Philistines will be to Israel what the Jebusites were to David and Solomon, while he that remaineth of Israel “shall be as a governor in Judah.” The pride of the Philistines is cut off, and the order is turned back the way God set it.

precepts.label: Exodus 2:25
precepts.why:
Zechariah 9:8: “And I will encamp about mine house because of the army, because of him that passeth by, and because of him that returneth: and no oppressor shall pass through them any more: for now have I seen with mine eyes.” No oppressor shall oppress us any more; they will not pass through.

And “now have I seen with mine eyes” is the same as Exodus 2:25: “And God looked upon the children of Israel, and God had respect unto them.” In Egypt God looked upon Israel under their oppressors and had respect unto them, and then he brought them out.

So when he says now have I seen with mine eyes, he is looking upon us to have respect unto us. The Lord encamps about his house, the oppressor is stopped, and right after it Zechariah says “Rejoice greatly, O daughter of Zion”, because the King comes.
